digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler config / jira_family adapter status maps
propositions: config.local_to_jira_status is a third independent literal copy of the canonical LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py, currently content-identical but unguarded against drift
mutating config.local_to_jira_status with an invalid workflow value leaves all existing tests passing, exposing a gap in test coverage
a parity test must assert full-dict equality between config.local_to_jira_status and the canonical map via the existing _load_attr helper, without importing the adapter into core config
config.py must remain a zero-dependency module that imports nothing outside __future__, preserving the one-way dependency direction of the adapter layer
